compatibility_note: Bundle refresh r131: Networks 1.0.51 fixes Crafter Manager display updates passing a nested SlimefunItemStack delegate into CraftInventory on Paper/Purpur 1.21.11. Existing validation files in this archive describe the original revision-130 build; this refresh does not certify arbitrary historical worlds, the user's complete 82-plugin stack, or Folia region behavior.
